graduation_clearance.ceb: Mag-file unta ko sa akong graduation clearance.
graduation_clearance.en: I'd like to file my graduation clearance.

graduation_clearance.ceb: Graduating na ko! Kompleto na ni akong papeles, sigurado ko.
graduation_clearance.en: I'm graduating! My papers are complete, I'm sure.

graduation_clearance.ceb: Palihug, ipa-check nako akong checklist para sa graduation.

enroll_subject.en: I'd like to enroll in {course}, section {section}.

enroll_subject.ceb: Pwede ko magpa-enroll sa {course}? Mao ni akong form.
enroll_subject.en: Can I enroll in {course}? Here's my form.

enrollment_payment.ceb: Mag-enroll ko para ani nga sem. Bayad na ko, ha.
enrollment_payment.en: I'm enrolling for this sem. I've already paid, okay?

enrollment_payment.ceb: Ania akong assessment, palihug ko i-process.
enrollment_payment.en: Here's my assessment, please process it.

first_year.ceb: Bag-o pa ko diri. Asa man ko mag-enroll?
first_year.en: I'm new here. Where do I enroll?

first_year.ceb: Freshman ko. Ania akong mga papeles.
first_year.en: I'm a freshman. Here are my papers.

add_subject.ceb: Mag-add unta ko og {course}. Pirmado na ni Sir.
add_subject.en: I'd like to add {course}. Sir already signed it.

no_id.ceb: Nawala akong ID. Ang akong number kay {id}.
no_id.en: I lost my ID. My number is {id}.

no_id.ceb: Nabilin nako akong ID sa boarding house. {id} akong ID number.
no_id.en: I left my ID at the boarding house. My ID number is {id}.

cashier.ceb: Bayad na ko sa Cashier. Ania ang resibo.
cashier.en: I've paid at the Cashier. Here's the receipt.

consultation.ceb: Napirmahan na ni Sir. Ania na.
consultation.en: Sir signed it now. Here you go.

consultation.ceb: Okay na daw sabi sa adviser. Ania iyang sulat.
consultation.en: The adviser says it's okay. Here's the note.

dean.ceb: Gi-approve na sa Dean ang akong overload.

cashier.ceb: Ingon sa Cashier wala man koy utang! Nganong didto ko nimo gipaadto?
cashier.en: The Cashier said I don't owe anything! Why did you send me there?

consultation.ceb: Ingon sa adviser dili daw na iyaha. Nausik akong oras.
consultation.en: The adviser said that's not their job. I wasted my time.

dean.ceb: Wala daw labot ang Dean ana. Mibalik ko diri.
dean.en: The Dean's office said it's not their concern. So I'm back.

closed.ceb: Sirado man ang opisina! Naghulat lang ko didto.
closed.en: The office was closed! I just stood there waiting.

ismis_login.ceb: Dili ko maka-login sa ISMIS. Unsaon man ni?
ismis_login.en: I can't log in to ISMIS. What do I do?

ismis_login.ceb: Locked daw akong account. Tabang, palihug.
ismis_login.en: It says my account is locked. Help, please.

held.en: Okay, I'll wait on the bench.

wrong.ceb: Ngano man? Sakto man akong papeles!

returned_angry.ceb: Mibalik ko kay sayop imong gisulti!
returned_angry.en: I'm back because you told me wrong!

returned_angry.ceb: Nag-usik ko og oras tungod nimo.
returned_angry.en: I wasted my time because of you.

returned.ceb: Ok na, nahuman na nako didto.

requirement.ceb: Ay, nakalimtan nako ang {item}. Sorry kaayo.
requirement.en: Oh, I forgot the {item}. I'm so sorry.

requirement.ceb: Wala pa diay ko kakuha sa {item}...

signature_blank.ceb: Wala pa diay napirmahan ni Sir. Akong balikan.
signature_blank.en: Sir hasn't signed it yet. I'll go back to him.

signature_fake.ceb: Ako ra ang nagpirma, wala man gud si Sir...
signature_fake.en: I signed it myself, Sir wasn't around...

balance.ceb: Ay, wala pa diay nako nabayran ang tanan.
balance.en: Oh, I haven't paid all of it yet.

birthday.ceb: Ah... dili diay ni akoa. Gipangayo ra sa akong ig-agaw.
birthday.en: Ah... it's not actually mine. My cousin asked me to do it.

harmless_name.ceb: Gipamubo ra na nako akong pangalan. Ako ra gyud na.
harmless_name.en: I just shortened my name. That's really me.

harmless_program.ceb: Pareho ra man na nga course, gisulat lang lahi.
harmless_program.en: That's the same course, just written differently.

same.ceb: Pareho ra man na, di ba?
